gdpr_compliance.comment: GDPR compliance (privacy settings) is enabled for this org.

hipaa_compliance.comment: HIPAA compliance is not enabled — only required if you handle protected health information (PHI).

user_licences.comment: Licence count not available via API — check Setup → Subscription → User Licences.

audit_log.comment: Audit log status cannot be read via API — verify manually. Recommended: export logs monthly.

password_policy.comment: No API available to read password policy — verify manually. Recommended: min 8 chars, mixed case, 90-day expiry.

two_factor_auth.comment: No API available to read two-factor auth settings — verify manually. Recommended: enforce for all users.

ip_restrictions.comment: No API available to read IP restriction settings — verify manually. Recommended: restrict to office/VPN ranges.

ai_summary.summary: The CRM is generally compliant with GDPR and has a well-defined territory structure. However, key security settings such as HIPAA, password policy, TFA and IP restrictions are not verifiable via API and require manual review.
critical: HIPAA compliance is not enabled — poses a risk if the organisation handles protected health information (PHI).
Two-factor authentication settings must be manually verified — enforcement is recommended for all users, especially administrators.
warnings: Password policy is not configured and cannot be read via API — minimum 8 characters, mixed case and 90-day expiry are recommended.
IP restrictions are not configured and cannot be read via API — restrict to known office or VPN IP ranges.
Audit log status is not available via API — manual verification required; monthly exports are recommended.
positives: GDPR compliance is enabled, ensuring privacy settings meet required standards.
35 territories are configured, providing a clear organisational structure.
recommended_actions: Manually verify and enable HIPAA compliance in Setup → Security Control if PHI is processed.
Enforce two-factor authentication for all users via Setup → Security Control → Two-Factor Authentication.
Review and configure password policy to require at least 8 characters, mixed case and expiry every 90 days.
Check and restrict IP access to known office or VPN ranges in Setup → Security Control → Allowed IP Addresses.
Export audit logs monthly to ensure compliance and monitor user activity.
